column1: # comment: "Archaeological evidence alignments: CIDOC-CRM E34 Inscription, E19 Physical Object, CRMsci S4 Observation, CRMinf I1 Argumentation / I2 Belief, PROV-O Activity, and Web Annotation. The gmeow:InscriptionReading, InscriptionTransliteration, InscriptionTranslation, ScriptLanguageAttribution, and ArchaeologicalFindContext are all Observation subclasses; they align to CRM E13 Attribute Assignment and CRMsci S4 Observation at the superclass level (see equivalences/observations.ttl). This file adds the domain-specific term alignments."

column6: CRMarchaeo A2 is the stratigraphic volume unit; GMEOW ArchaeologicalFindContext is an Observation relator that binds carrier, place, stratigraphy, dating, and event. The match is loose because A2 is a spatial-stratigraphic entity, while ArchaeologicalFindContext is a claim/observation about that entity.

CIDOC-CRM E34 is the closest term for a sign-bearing information object. GMEOW Inscription is broader than E34 (covers marks, symbols, and non-linguistic signs) and is explicitly an InformationObject, not a Man-Made Thing.
CRMsci S4 Observation covers scientific observations including archaeological readings. The alignment is at the superclass level: InscriptionReading is a domain-specific Observation.

A scholarly reading can be modeled as a Web Annotation: the inscription is the target, the LexicalForm is the body, and the scholar is the creator. This is a lossy projection (standpoint, confidence, and determinacy are dropped).
A scholarly reading is an Activity in PROV-O terms: an agent performs it, it has a start/end, and it generates a result (the LexicalForm).
GMEOW PhysicalObject is the material carrier; E19 is the closest CRM class. E24 Physical Human-Made Thing is a narrower match when the object is known to be human-made.

CRMinf I1 Argumentation is the closest term for a scholarly claim assigning language/script to an inscription. The ScriptLanguageAttribution also aligns to I5 Inference Making when the classification is inferred from palaeographic evidence.
When the language/script attribution is inferred from evidence (palaeography, stratigraphy, etc.), it is an instance of I5 Inference Making.
crm:P128 carries (information): the physical object carries the inscription.
The stratigraphic unit referenced by findContextStratigraphy aligns to CRMarchaeo A2 when the unit is modeled in CRMarchaeo.
crm:P128i is carried by (information): the inscription is carried by the physical object.
The lexical form produced by a reading is generated by the reading activity.
